value.rationale: The natural flat meet-semilattice is an extremal family in the 2026 open DSC-coefficient enumeration direction. Complete size and symmetry enumerations and an asymptotically exact superexponential law are accompanied by a genuine typical-structure theorem: almost every compatible reflexive relation is a uniformly random directed graph on top of saturated zero-coordinate arms. It supplies a previously uncomputed sharp Clifford coefficient bound rather than arbitrary finite data.
